title: $τ$-Rec: A Verifiable Benchmark for Agentic Recommender Systems
title_zh: τ-Rec：面向 Agentic Recommender Systems 的可验证基准
abstract_en: As recommender systems transition toward agentic, multi-turn conversational interfaces, evaluation paradigms have struggled to keep pace. Current benchmarks often rely on "LLM-as-a-judge" evaluations, which introduce subjectivity, high costs and inconsistency. We present $τ$-Rec, a benchmark for agentic recommender systems that replaces subjective evaluation with verifiable rewards and a reveal-tagged elicitation (RTE) mechanism that controls how task constraints surface during dialogue. By testing agents against structured catalog predicates and employing a pass^k reliability metric, $τ$-Rec provides a systematic test for consistent reasoning. Our evaluation of nine configurations across five model families -- GPT-5.4, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3-32B and GPT-5 mini -- reveals a steep reliability cliff, where even the best model achieves only ~57% at pass^1 and ~38% at pass^4, highlighting a critical gap in current conversational agent deployment. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec.
abstract_zh: 随着推荐系统逐渐转向具备智能体能力的多轮对话界面，现有评测范式已难以跟上发展。许多当前基准依赖 “LLM-as-a-judge” 评估，带来主观性、高成本与不一致性。本文提出 τ-Rec，一个面向 agentic recommender systems 的基准，用可验证奖励替代主观评判，并引入 reveal-tagged elicitation（RTE）机制，用于控制任务约束在对话过程中如何显露。τ-Rec 通过结构化 catalog predicates 测试智能体，并采用 pass^k 可靠性指标，系统评估其一致推理能力。作者评测了横跨五个模型家族的九种配置，包括 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Qwen3-32B 和 GPT-5 mini。结果显示明显的可靠性断崖：即便最佳模型也仅达到约 57% 的 pass^1 和约 38% 的 pass^4，说明当前对话式推荐智能体在部署可靠性上仍存在关键缺口。代码与数据已开源于 https://github.com/nbharaths/tau-rec。
key_points_zh: 提出 τ-Rec，用可验证奖励替代 LLM-as-a-judge，降低主观性、成本和评估不一致问题。
设计 reveal-tagged elicitation（RTE）机制，控制用户约束在多轮对话中逐步显露的方式，更贴近真实推荐场景。
通过结构化 catalog predicates 检查推荐结果是否满足任务约束，并用 pass^k 衡量多次交互下的可靠性。
在 GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 2.5 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Qwen3-32B、GPT-5 mini 等模型上评测，发现可靠性显著不足。
最佳模型仅约 57% pass^1、约 38% pass^4，表明当前 agentic conversational recommender 距离稳定部署仍有明显差距。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong e-commerce-agent benchmark that addresses verifiable evaluation for conversational recommender reliability.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一篇有价值的电商智能体推荐评测论文，重点解决对话式推荐可靠性的可验证评估问题。
